default.notes: Apply for the tourist eVisa at evisa.gov.et before travel (30 or 90 days, single entry) — visas on arrival are no longer reliably issued.

groups.notes: Kenyan citizens enter Ethiopia visa-free under a bilateral agreement — commonly reported as up to one year; confirm the stay granted on arrival.
Djiboutian citizens enter Ethiopia visa-free under a bilateral agreement — confirm the permitted length of stay before travel.

ET.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Ethiopian citizens.
